encoded: नमस्ते दुनिया, यह एक परीक्षण है।
generator_cmd: hand-written Hindi sentence: its Mn vowel signs / virama are part of the script; stripped remainder is not ASCII
oracle_cmd: printf %s "$encoded" | uconv -x '::NFD; [[:Mn:][:Me:]] > ; ::NFC;'  # ICU transliterator: NFD, remove Mn/Me, NFC
oracle_note: raw combining marks in blob: 2; ICU strip -> 'नमसत दनिया, यह एक परीकषण ह।' (ascii=False)
